name: Short Drama (Quick Test)
description: For quickly validating the dynamic short drama workflow: story planning, character anchors, storyboard, video, voiceover, and automatic composition.

planning.planning_notes: This is a lightweight test flow; complex production short dramas keep using the original short-drama Skill. First settle visual_style: if the user confirmed a visual style, fill in its meaning; if not, fill in "Unspecified" and do not choose a style yourself. A confirmed style must reach every image and video task itself, or be consumed through prompt_for/context_for from an upstream text node that contains it; an image asset edge or a Plan input alone does not count as passing it on. Every shot item must have a title, a prompt and a non-empty narration; narration is the one line of voiceover or dialogue actually spoken in that shot.
planning.prompt_guide: Keep character identity, wardrobe, scene and story continuous; each plan item is one story shot. A confirmed visual style must be traceable in the visual task's image prompt or in upstream text it consumes; if unconfirmed, do not impose a style. The prompt describes only the picture; narration holds only the voiceover or dialogue spoken in that shot, with no timecodes, durations, emotion tags, ambience, sound effects or music notes.
conduct_rules: Decide the number of nodes and their dependencies from the user's goal
Use only the capabilities declared in allowed_recipe_ids
Generate and confirm a dynamic plan before creating canvas nodes
Never skip the visual style decision: put a confirmed style in visual_style and pass it to the visual tasks; if unconfirmed, fill in "Unspecified" and never impose one

input_parameters.label: Confirmed visual style (write "Unspecified" if not confirmed)

rating_bands.description: Fully meets the user's goal and the workflow can run
Core flow is complete; minor non-critical adjustments allowed
Missing key stages or incomplete dependencies

domain_constraints: The workflow must match the user's goal and keep input assets consistent
